sections.heading: A — Exam authority
sections.markdown:
## A — Exam authority

The selected pages of this section cover the three categories of traffic control devices and the meaning of yellow and white centerlines, lane lines, edge lines, stop and crosswalk lines, two-way left turn lanes, obstruction, directional and railroad markings, and traffic islands; they teach the meaning of pavement markings and say nothing about any examination; they state no exam name, question count, passing standard, format or time limit.

The run scope names the Hawaii Department of Transportation as the handbook issuer and the twenty twenty-three printing as the edition, but these pages carry no page-bound issuer or edition statement, so part A asserts no issuer or edition fact of its own.

Question count, passing standard, format and time limit for the class three knowledge test are not stated anywhere in this manual; every official exam fact stays unknown in this envelope and is never guessed.

Corpus note: marking colors, patterns and meanings are national conventions printed as stable knowledge in this twenty twenty-three edition with no annual-rewrite signal on these pages.

corpus_stability.reason: The Hawaii Driver's Manual is a periodically reprinted reference (imprint HMG 5/2023, copyright line through 2023); the the three categories of traffic control devices and the meaning of yellow and white centerlines, lane lines, edge lines, stop and crosswalk lines, two-way left turn lanes, obstruction, directional and railroad markings, and traffic islands rules on pages 33–38 are statutory and procedural content that changes less than once a year, so no BlockedProbe.
